{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too low during uptrends, showing 0.5-2.0 euro lag behind true prices",
    "When prices are flat, model outputs overestimate current levels by 0.3-0.8 euro, showing mean-reversion bias",
    "High sentiment (>=0.67) correlates with 0.8-1.5 euro price bumps that model misses",
    "Model fails to capture sentiment-driven volatility spikes, especially when sentiment shifts from low to high",
    "When price has been rising rapidly (8+ days), model underforecasts by 1-2 euro compared to true levels",
    "Sentiment turning negative predicts 0.3-0.6 euro price corrections that model delays",
    "Model over-smooths prices, missing 10-20% daily volatility that sentiment amplifies"
] }
